name: Durai Gajendran M
bio: Born and raised in Kovilpatti, Gajendran started SaivaTech after seeing local shop owners and academies struggle with expensive, over-complicated software. He designs simple, high-performing automation funnels that directly bring in sales.

name: Santhiya D
bio: Santhiya is our WhatsApp API and AI chatbot specialist. She builds authorized Meta integrations that automate customer inquiries. She has helped 12+ businesses across Tamil Nadu replace manual typing with 30-second automated responses.

name: Priyanka G
bio: Priyanka is a frontend engineering specialist. She focuses on building websites that load in under 2 seconds, even on budget Android phones and slow 3G/4G connections common in semi-urban Tamil Nadu.

name: Mathumitha N
bio: Mathumitha is our UX developer. She designs clean, jargon-free interfaces so that anybody—regardless of their technical background—can easily navigate and complete actions on our websites.
